prompt: Provide the `AndroidManifest.xml` intent-filter configuration for handling custom scheme deep links into the app.
raw_response:
AndroidManifest.xml
```xml
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools">

    <!--
        Security notes for the operator:
        - android:exported="true" is required for the OS to deliver external deep links,
          but the activity MUST validate every intent extra and URI through the single
          allowlist resolver before any navigation or state change.
        - taskAffinity="" prevents the deep-link activity from being launched into a
          task that could be hijacked by another app.
        - launchMode="singleTask" ensures onNewIntent is called for subsequent links
          while the app is running; the resolver must be invoked from BOTH onCreate
          and onNewIntent.
        - No authority, role, or identity is ever derived from the URI. The link may
          only navigate to an allowlisted route with typed, bounded parameters.
    -->

    <application
        android:allowBackup="false"
        android:fullBackupContent="false"
        android:dataExtractionRules="@xml/data_extraction_rules"
        android:usesCleartextTraffic="false">

        <activity
            android:name=".ui.DeepLinkActivity"
            android:exported="true"
            android:launchMode="singleTask"
            android:taskAffinity=""
            android:noHistory="true"
            android:excludeFromRecents="true"
            android:screenOrientation="portrait"
            tools:ignore="LockedOrientationActivity">

            <!--
                Custom scheme deep link.
                The scheme is intentionally non-generic to reduce collision risk.
                Only the exact scheme and host are accepted by the resolver.
            -->
            <intent-filter android:label="@string/app_name">
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />

                <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.BROWSABLE" />

                <data
                    android:scheme="myapp"
                    android:host="open" />
            </intent-filter>

            <!--
                Optional: HTTPS App Links for verified domains.
                Keep this only if you control the domain and publish the
                assetlinks.json file. The resolver still applies the same
                allowlist and typed-parameter rules.
            -->
            <intent-filter android:autoVerify="true">
                <action android:name="android.intent.action.VIEW" />

                <category android:name="android.intent.category.DEFAULT" />
                <category android:name="android.intent.category.BROWSABLE" />

                <data
                    android:scheme="https"
                    android:host="links.example.com"
                    android:pathPrefix="/app" />
            </intent-filter>
        </activity>
    </application>
</manifest>
```
